title: Relative Clauses
rule: Relative clauses give extra information about a noun.

examples.text: The man who called is my uncle.
This is the book that I recommended.
She met a friend who lives abroad.
The restaurant which we tried was excellent.
People who exercise regularly feel better.

practicePrompt: Complete: The woman ___ lives next door is a nurse.
